description: This file defines the TagsController class which handles HTTP GET requests for tags via a REST API. It uses MediatR for mediating requests and is part of the 'Conduit.Features.Tags' namespace in an ASP.NET Core project.

classes.name: TagsController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core controller responsible for handling tag-related HTTP requests. It uses dependency injection to receive an IMediator instance and handles GET requests to retrieve tags.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request for the 'tags' route, invoking MediatR to send a List.Query and returning a Task with a TagsEnvelope containing the list of tags.
